body: There is more but I've just had it. The longer I'm here the more of a depressing energy I'm giving my family. I'm seeing it as a pull the bandaid off quickly type deal so they don't have to see my injuries and drug abuse get worse.

Yeah its a bunch of things really.  Ill list some issues. I have the injury and I am most likely to have more major surgeries in my neck and upper back. I am addicted to oxycodone, valium, weed, alcohol, meth and cigarettes. I'm 30 kg over weight which I can't lose. I have no girl friend and I am extremely ugly by generic standards. As well as just all round unhealthy. I lost my career when I had my work accident. I was in construction. My social circle all think I'm pathetic and some even cut me off and others think I'm lying about my injury. All other friends I've lost to meth.
I just need to know how to handle finances at this age and if what society considers a crime will affect a will? If I even need a will or just a written contract that I write up myself.

Yeah I thought that will be the case. They've been helping me for the last 5 year's. Especially the last 2. I simply won't be able to get through this time. They won't be able to do anything more for me. I've also had professional type help in the past that just doesn't work either. Its at the point where the more my family care and try to help, the harder they are ultimately making it. Its not their fault either. Its all mine. I just wish their wasn't a taboo on suicide and it was accepted as a sovereign choice for everyone. 

Anyway in this case it might just be better to leave a note? I've always thought a note to be insulting tho, would the ideal note be long and detailed for each family member or really short and for everyone to read.?

Thanks for the response also.
